about: The editor's missile spread rows (SeekingMissile +0xB4..+0xF4): the W.A.S.P. missile's spread switched off (record 9 +0xB4), the MLS-4X Commando's switched on with a 45 degree veer to one side between 0.05 and 0.4 s and a 1 s return (record 10). The logs prove the edits land; what they do (a W.A.S.P. salvo that flies straight at its target without fanning out, Commando rockets that swerve 45 degrees sideways and curve back onto the laser point) needs a look in the mission with each weapon fired (tests/in-game/README.md).

checks.name: the W.A.S.P. missile's spread goes off
the Commando veers 90 degrees round its flight line
the Commando's veer runs from 0.05 s to 0.4 s
the Commando swings back over 1 s at its usual turn rate
